The '''Detached Duty Office''' was a division of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Office of the Auditor-General]]. It was established for two reasons; firstly, as a public relations exercise to give the impression that the Corporate Sector Authority valued civic-mindedness. Secondly, as an internal affairs department to counter corruption in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. The Office answered to the [[Prex]] and the [[Executive Directorship Board]], but had full authority to investigate the Prex, the [[ExO]], and the Direx Board.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
